# upwind_threat_policy_rule (Resource)

Manages the attachment of an Upwind threat rule definition to a threat policy, optionally overriding the policy's severity and resource scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A policy rule ATTACHES a rule definition to a policy. It is the join between
# the two, not a copy of the logic: destroying it detaches the rule and leaves
# the definition intact.
resource "upwind_threat_policy_rule" "prod_waf" {
  policy_id          = upwind_threat_policy.production_only.id
  rule_definition_id = upwind_threat_rule_definition.waf_deletion.id
}

# The same definition attached to a second policy, with overrides. Omit
# severity or scope to inherit the policy's; set them to override.
resource "upwind_threat_policy_rule" "sandbox_waf" {
  policy_id          = upwind_threat_policy.org_wide.id
  rule_definition_id = upwind_threat_rule_definition.waf_deletion.id

  severity = "low"

  scope = {
    condition = {
      type     = "cloud_account_rule"
      field    = "cloud_account_id"
      operator = "in"
      value    = ["123456789012"]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_id` (String) ID of the threat policy this rule is attached to. Immutable: changing it forces replacement.
- `rule_definition_id` (String) ID of the rule definition to attach. Immutable: changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether this rule is enabled within the policy. The platform reports the effective state, so a rule inside a policy with `is_enabled = false` reads back as `false` whatever is set here - enable the policy to enable its rules. Omit to inherit.
- `scope` (Attributes) Resource scope override for this rule. Omit to inherit the policy's scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope))
- `severity` (String) Severity override for this rule. One of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical`. Omit to inherit the policy's severity. Removing it replaces the rule, because the API has no way to clear an override in place.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) ISO8601 timestamp when the attachment was created.
- `creator_id` (String) ID of the user or client that created this attachment.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this attachment (server-generated). Maps to the API's `policy_rule_id`.
- `is_suspended` (Boolean) Whether this rule is currently suspended (silenced) by the platform.
- `last_modifier_id` (String) ID of the user or client that last modified this attachment.
- `rule_definition_name` (String) Display name of the attached rule definition.
- `scope_type` (String) Source of the effective scope. The API documents an enum of `policy_scope`, `rule_scope`, `override`, `no_scope`, but returns an empty string for a rule that overrides nothing, so treat any value other than `rule_scope` or `override` as inherited.
- `threat_category` (String) Threat category inherited from the attached rule definition.
- `update_time` (String) ISO8601 timestamp when the attachment was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope`

Optional:

- `condition` (Attributes) A single scope-matching rule. Omit for no scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope--condition))

<a id="nestedatt--scope--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope.condition`

Required:

- `field` (String) Field to match against.
- `operator` (String) Match operator. One of `equals`, `not_equals`, `in`, `not_in`.
- `type` (String) Condition type. One of `cloud_account_rule`, `cloud_account_ou_rule`, `cloud_account_organization_rule`, `cloud_provider_rule`, `cluster_id_rule`. The composite `filter` type is not supported.
- `value` (Set of String) Values to match against. Unordered (a set).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A policy rule lives under a policy, so it imports by a composite address:
#   <policy-id>/<policy-rule-id>
terraform import upwind_threat_policy_rule.prod_waf cp-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/cpr-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
